children: According to Wallstreetcn, the Israel Defense Forces said it carried out airstrikes in southern Lebanon on the 6th in response to Hezbollah activity, after Hezbollah fighters launched two drones at Israeli soldiers operating in Lebanon's southern "security zone" earlier in the day; the military said it shot down one of the drones and no Israeli personnel were injured.

title: Israel Says It Struck Southern Lebanon in Response to Hezbollah Action
